## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test` passes (a new tool needs tests for valid input, invalid input and an edge case)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] No new heavy dependency (or it is justified and lazy-loaded)
- [ ] Runs locally in the browser — no user data is sent anywhere (or it is clearly disclosed on the tool page)
- [ ] Works with the keyboard and on a narrow (≈320 px) screen
- [ ] `npm run docs:tools` re-run if tools were added or renamed
